reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that in sparse data regimes, traditional point estimates lead to overconfident predictions. Partial ranking and conformal prediction offer principled ways to bound uncertainty without assuming full data richness. The Humility CI Rule enforces that no pick be locked unless its 95% interval excludes 0.5, preventing false certainty. Calibration Dashboards monitor these rules in real time, ensuring model integrity. These primitives form a coherent system where GSE's margin model is wrapped in a CPD to yield calibrated posteriors, while the dashboard provides feedback loops for operational adjustments. This architecture avoids ad hoc caps and instead uses data-driven thresholds derived from missingness patterns and posterior separations.
